name: @shiba/sdk
description: Zero-dependency TypeScript client for the Shiba public API (/api/v1).

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate:types && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm run generate:types && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/report-size.mjs
